scope: Generic job and KB import retry policy on ephemeral Temporal engine
checks: KB import retryable errors stop after two real activity attempts
Other generic jobs retain three attempts
Failed attempts retain job/tenant/execution identity and report failed status without completed status
Successful second KB attempt returns import totals and completed status

validation.mutation: Changing KB maximumAttempts from2 to3 fails the attempt-count assertion; source restored

limits: Activities are synthetic; does not verify actual article writes or dialog polling timeout
No production history replay compatibility claim
